basic_info.description: Situated on a beautiful block of one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods, this elegant, top floor condo in a two-unit building offers a surprising array of features and storage in its thoughtful layout. Step into the sunlit, open concept living space, which is ideal for entertaining and features a fireplace, bright dining area and a well-equipped kitchen with abundant storage, including a wine fridge. The updated bathroom boasts a double sink, a walk-in shower, heated floors and generous storage. The spacious primary bedroom offers serene views of Cole Valley and a large closet outfitted with a customizable Elfa system. The second bedroom opens to a west facing deck where you can enjoy sunsets and sweeping views from Sutro Tower to the Marin Headlands. Other features of this Spanish inspired 1940's construction condo include hardwood floors, period moldings, two hallway closets, in-unit laundry, a shared yard, independent garage parking, and even more deeded storage in the garage.    Cole Valley is a lovely, centrally located and walkable village close to shops, restaurants, bars, bakeries, a gym and a gourmet grocery store. The N Judah runs right through the neighborhood, making it easy to get to the beach and downtown without having to drive.
